element.name: Balat-Kayo
element.description: Made in the image of Haliya's tusked mask, balat-kayo are proud, dutiful, and passionate people. They possess a tracing of starlight across their body, and their eyes are a splendid silver.

element.name: Relentless Endurance (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

element.name: Weapon Training (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: You gain proficiency with simple and martial weapons.

element.name: Blessing of Haliya
element.description: You know the alarm, detect poison and disease, and identify spells. You can cast each of these spells once as a ritual, and regain the ability to do so after a long rest. When you reach 3rd level, you learn one other spell of 2nd level or lower with the ritual tag. When you reach 5th level, you learn another spell of 3rd level or lower with the ritual tag. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feature.

element.name: Umalagad Dragonborn
element.description: Umalagad dragonborn live a second life—having already lived a life, and now back from the dead. They are commonly albino and take on aspects of pythons and crocodiles.

element.name: Blindsight (Umalagad)
element.description: You have blindsight out to 30 feet. You can perceive surroundings within this radius without relying on visual sight.

element.name: Ancestral Protection
element.description: You know the guidance cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the sanctuary spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the warding bond spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

element.name: Volcano Dwarf
element.description: Named for the magma formations that they can produce on their skin and their ash-like trailing hair.

element.name: Molten Armor
element.description: As a bonus action, you can cover your form with a protective shield of hardened lava. You gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your character level, and whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes fire damage equal to your character level. The temporary hit points last for 1 hour. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

element.name: Balete Elf
element.description: A balete elf typically has plant roots—akin to that of a balete tree—growing throughout their hair.

element.name: Verdant Intuition
element.description: When you make an Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Survival) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

element.name: Spirit of Nature
element.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the entangle spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the barkskin spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

element.name: Gold Gnome
element.description: Gold gnomes are born with natural tattoo-like patterns sprawling across their skin, which take on the lustrous hue of their namesake.

element.name: Keen Eyes
element.description: You gain proficiency in the Perception skill.

element.name: Gilded Gifts
element.description: During a long rest, you can utilize your innate connection with gold to gild an item and imbue it with magical benefits. These benefits last for 24 hours. Choose one option: Gilded Armor (temp HP equal to 5 + Cha mod); Gilded Tools (creature uses your prof bonus + Cha mod); Gilded Weapon (counts as magical, first hit is an automatic critical).

element.name: Mangrove Halfling
element.description: Patterns reminiscent of the mangrove tree decorate the mangrove halfling.

element.name: Natural Craftsmanship
element.description: You know the mending cantrip.

element.name: Quick Thinker
element.description: You can take the Help action as a bonus action on your turn.

element.name: Carabao Tiefling
element.description: Tieflings with the horns of carabao command great physical prowess. Strong and resilient, their closeness to nature is reflected by their horns and physique.

element.name: Immovable
element.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone, pushed, grappled, or restrained.

element.name: Legacy of Might
element.description: You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. Additionally, when you make a successful melee weapon attack, you can choose to deal the attack's maximum possible damage instead of rolling the damage dice. You can do this a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum once), and regain all uses after a long rest.

element.name: Deer Tiefling
element.description: Tieflings with the horns of deer share an innate connection to fire that is not hellish in origin, but rather used to perpetuate the cycle of growth.

element.name: Hellish Resistance
element.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

element.name: Infernal Legacy
element.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the hellish rebuke spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the darkness spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

element.name: Human
element.description: Not linked to one particular spirit or place, humans roam the islands, creating their own long-standing histories and connections for generations to come.

element.name: Half-Elf
element.description: In the islands, half-elves are nature spirits that have taken on a mortal form from the bountiful wild flowers. They use standard Half-Elf statistics.

element.name: Fey Ancestry
element.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

element.name: Skill Versatility
element.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

element.name: Babaylan
element.description: Babaylan are mediums, channeling the power and wisdom of the spirits through offerings and communion. Accompanied by a patron spirit companion known as an abayan, babaylan serve as leaders, protectors, and healers for their communities.

setters.set: Choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Persuasion, and Religion

element.name: Spellcasting (Babaylan)
element.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your babaylan spells. You prepare a number of spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + your babaylan level (minimum one). Cantrips: 3 at 1st level. Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Int modifier. Spell attack modifier = proficiency bonus + Int modifier. You can cast babaylan spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag and you have them prepared.

element.name: Abayan
element.description: Your journey is guided by a steadfast spirit companion known as an abayan. It manifests as an incorporeal semi-transparent creature of Medium size with truesight 60 ft., immune to all damage, and cannot be dismissed or dispelled. You can use it as a spellcasting focus. As a bonus action, you can direct it to move up to 30 ft. It can deliver touch spells and originate area spells.

element.name: Babaylan Calling
element.description: Choose a Babaylan Calling: Call of Clairvoyance, Call of Sacrifice, or Call of Wrath. Your choice grants features at 1st, 2nd, 6th, 11th, and 15th levels.

element.name: Spirit Conduit
element.description: Your abayan lends you a pool of d4s called Spirit Dice (4d4 at 3rd level, increasing with level). You can expend dice to bolster spells: Persistence (increase spell save DC), Precision (add to spell attack roll), or Vehemence (add to spell damage). Total dice expended per turn ≤ Int modifier (minimum 1). Regain all after a long rest.

element.name: Spirit Recovery
element.description: During a short rest, regain Spirit Dice up to half your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum 1). You also gain resistance to necrotic damage.

element.name: Preternatural Speaker
element.description: You can speak and read all languages, and any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.

element.name: Walker Between Worlds
element.description: You are immune to necrotic damage and have advantage on death saving throws.

element.name: Mythic Reverence
element.description: Whenever you start your turn with fewer than half your hit point maximum and are not incapacitated, you automatically regain 20 hit points. Additionally, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead (three uses, regained after a long rest).

element.name: Call of Clairvoyance
element.description: Babaylan who heed the Call of Clairvoyance specialize in divination and history, opening their bodies as vessels for spirits to pour forth guidance, knowledge, and memories.

element.name: Divining Eye
element.description: You learn the true strike cantrip. You can cast it as a bonus action, and you cannot lose concentration on it as a result of taking damage.

element.name: Vessel for the Spirits
element.description: As an action, your abayan enters your body for 10 minutes. You gain advantage on Intelligence checks to recall knowledge, add Int modifier to concentration saves, and can cast detect evil and good, detect poison and disease, and identify once each without expending spell slots.

element.name: Clarity of Mind
element.description: You are immune to being charmed or frightened.

element.name: Piercing Sight
element.description: You gain truesight out to 30 feet when using Vessel for the Spirits.

element.name: Living Memory
element.description: Touch an object or creature to glimpse significant events from its past. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Call of Sacrifice
element.description: Experts in healing and herbalism, babaylan following the Call of Sacrifice dedicate themselves to remedying the hurts that plague their communities.

element.name: Undanted Healer
element.description: Whenever your abayan is within 30 feet of you and you cast a spell to restore hit points, add your proficiency bonus to the hit points regained.

element.name: Absolve Hurt
element.description: Friendly creatures within 10 ft. of your abayan gain +2 bonus to saving throws against damaging spells/effects. You can use your reaction to expend a spell slot and reduce damage by your babaylan level + 1d6 per slot level.

element.name: Yield Vitality
element.description: As an action, lose hit points equal to 10 × the spell slot level to restore one spell slot to a creature within 30 ft. of your abayan.

element.name: Hale of Body
element.description: You are immune to all poison and disease.

element.name: Banish Affliction
element.description: As an action, end one condition on yourself or a willing creature you touch. Uses = Int modifier (minimum 1).

element.name: Call of Wrath
element.description: Babaylan who heed the Call of Wrath wield menacing martial prowess alongside powerful sorcery, becoming fearsome warriors.

element.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Call of Wrath)
element.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

element.name: Guided Strikes
element.description: Whenever you are within 10 ft. of your abayan, you can use your Intelligence modifier for weapon attack and damage rolls.

element.name: Fury of the Spirits
element.description: When you take the Attack action, your abayan can make one melee spell attack (2d6 force damage, increasing at higher levels).

element.name: Magic Warrior
element.description: Your weapon attacks count as magical. When you use Spirit Conduit, you can apply Precision and Vehemence to weapon attacks.

element.name: Tempered Will
element.description: You can no longer lose concentration on a spell as a result of taking damage.

element.name: Armor of Ancients
element.description: As an action, call upon warrior babaylan spirits for 1 minute. You gain immunity to nonmagical B/P/S, resistance to all other damage, temp HP, and creatures that hit you with melee attacks take force damage.

element.name: Headhunter
element.description: Headhunters are trained to commune with the spirits of their ancestors, and it is via this connection that they hone their martial skill.

setters.set: Choose two from Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Religion, and Survival

element.name: Focused Hunter
element.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

element.name: Conviction
element.description: Once per round, when you target a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal 1d4 force damage to it (increases at higher levels).

element.name: Rite of the Ancestors
element.description: When you finish a long rest, choose a quarry and ask three questions about it from the list.

element.name: Fighting Style (Headhunter)
element.description: Choose a Fighting Style: Defense, Distance, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Pursuant, or Skirmisher.

element.name: Hunter's Omen
element.description: Choose a Hunter's Omen: Omen of Knowledge, Omen of Strife, or Omen of Swiftness.

element.name: Forgiveness for the Slain
element.description: Approach a corpse of a creature that died within the last 24 hours. Ask the spirit up to two questions.

element.name: Unwavering Hunter
element.description: You are immune to being charmed and frightened. Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

element.name: Tireless Pursuit
element.description: You can no longer receive levels of exhaustion from a forced march.

element.name: Dread Presence
element.description: Your movement no longer provokes attacks of opportunity.

element.name: Inevitable
element.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

element.name: Omen of Knowledge
element.description: Headhunters beset with an Omen of Knowledge carry the weight of what they've done with them every step of the way.

element.name: Lessons of the Departed
element.description: Gain proficiency in one saving throw and one skill/tool proficiency after a long rest.

element.name: Memories of War
element.description: Choose two Memory options. Gain more at 7th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

element.name: Study Remembrance
element.description: Gain resistance to one damage type after a short/long rest.

element.name: Inescapable End
element.description: If you roll initiative with less than half HP, regain HP equal to 10 × Int mod.

element.name: Memoriam
element.description: Replace one Memory option with another after a long rest.

element.name: Omen of Strife
element.description: Headhunters carrying an Omen of Strife embrace the violence of their profession with grim and fearsome skill.

element.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Omen of Strife)
element.description: Gain proficiency with heavy armor and Intimidation.

element.name: A Westriking Presence
element.description: As a bonus action, frighten a creature within 30 ft. (Wis save).

element.name: Formidable Conviction
element.description: Add 1d8 to Conviction force damage.

element.name: The Cost of Fear
element.description: On a hit, impose a cumulative -1 penalty to AC. Fades after 1 hour.

element.name: Retribution
element.description: Deal extra damage equal to the number of hit points you are missing.

element.name: Omen of Swiftness
element.description: Headhunters bestowed with an Omen of Swiftness learn to become channels for Amanikabli's power, using divine magic to aid their journey.

element.name: Spellcasting (Omen of Swiftness)
element.description: You learn cleric cantrips and spells. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

element.name: Devoted Soul
element.description: When you use Conviction, gain temp HP equal to half the force damage rolled.

element.name: Blessed Warrior
element.description: Your weapon attacks count as magical.

element.name: Grim Persistence
element.description: As a bonus action, teleport within 30 ft. of your quarry and attack with advantage.

element.name: Many-Limbed Silhouette
element.description: When you score a critical hit with a spell attack, make two weapon attacks with advantage as a bonus action.

element.name: Path of the Black River
element.description: The power of the Black River courses through you.

element.name: Isolation of the Soul
element.description: When you hit a creature while raging, force a Wisdom save (undead auto-fail). On a failure, the creature loses sight beyond 30 ft. You regain HP on successful attacks against it.

element.name: Treading Rampage
element.description: Spend HP as a reaction to end conditions (blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, etc.).

element.name: Living Tide
element.description: Cast dimension door. Bring additional creatures by spending HP.

element.name: Burial Shroud
element.description: While raging, move through creatures, deal psychic damage when ending turn inside them, and reduce max HP of the first target hit each turn.

element.name: College of Siday
element.description: Bards of the College of Siday serve as keepers of history.

element.name: Noble Fortitude
element.description: Exhaustion never imposes disadvantage. Add Cha mod to Song of Rest healing.

element.name: Folkloric Epics
element.description: Expend Bardic Inspiration to begin an Epic (Poem of the Ancients, Tale of the Warriors, Visage of the Sun).

element.name: Bolstering Verse
element.description: Advantage against charm/fear while performing. Cast enhance ability without a slot.

element.name: The Footsteps of Heroes
element.description: While performing an Epic: resistance to all damage, advantage on Dex saves, cause missed ally attacks to hit.

element.name: Volcano Domain
element.description: Clerics of the volcano domain channel the raw force that the volcano commands.

element.name: Domain Spells (Volcano)
element.description: 1st: create or harden lava, purify food and drink. 3rd: lesser restoration, molten shell. 5th: beacon of hope, eruption. 7th: control lava, fire shield. 9th: greater restoration, volcanic wall.

element.name: Volcanic Calling
element.description: Learn the light and mending cantrips. Gain proficiency in Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

element.name: Channel Divinity: Pyroclasm
element.description: Deal 3d6 + cleric level fire damage to hostile creatures within 15 ft. (Dex save halves). Heal friendly creatures for cleric level.

element.name: Revitalize and Renew
element.description: On a critical hit, a creature within 30 ft. regains HP equal to half the damage dealt.

element.name: Divine Strike (Volcano)
element.description: Deal an extra 1d8 fire damage on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th level).

element.name: Igneous Scion
element.description: Activate a 30 ft. aura. Stun hostiles, give allies +2 AC, and cast beacon of hope.

element.name: Circle of Tides
element.description: Druids of the Circle of Tides understand that nature is not something to be tamed.

element.name: Quiet Undercurrent
element.description: Commune with the world. Cannot be surprised. Ignore difficult terrain. Gain resistance to a chosen damage type.

element.name: Adaptation
element.description: Expend Wild Shape to adopt Alacrity, Balm, Earthquake, Shell, or Tidal Wave adaptation.

element.name: Ebb and Flow
element.description: Use reaction to take no damage from an attack and heal for half the damage dealt.

element.name: Shifting Sands
element.description: Swap initiative counts with a hostile creature before combat.

element.name: Increased Adaptation
element.description: Choose Regrowth, Roots, or Wind when using Adaptation.

element.name: Kawal
element.description: As a kawal, you are more than just a warrior. You are a guardian.

element.name: Steadfast Protector
element.description: Advantage against being grappled, poisoned, pushed, or restrained. Second Wind heals max HP.

element.name: Guardian Roar
element.description: Draw the attention of up to three creatures within 30 ft. (Wis save).

element.name: Counter Destruction
element.description: Use reaction to make a Con save to reflect damage back at the attacker.

element.name: Resolute Loyalty
element.description: Immune to charm and fear. Take up to two reactions per turn.

element.name: Warrior's Legacy
element.description: Gain ancestral protection (damage bonus, AC bonus, save advantages) for 1 minute.

element.name: Peerless Defense
element.description: Take up to three reactions per turn.

element.name: Way of Kaluluwa
element.description: Monks of the Way of Kaluluwa train to split their soul and body apart, having both fight alongside each other.

element.name: Temperament of the Soul
element.description: Unarmed strikes deal psychic damage instead of bludgeoning.

element.name: Schism of Self
element.description: Spend 2 ki to manifest your soul (translucent copy) for 1 minute. You and your soul share HP and turn.

element.name: Diversion of Magic
element.description: Spend 1 ki to reduce spell damage by 1d10 (2d10 at 11th).

element.name: Refinement of Aspects
element.description: Spend 1 ki to grant resistance to your soul or body.

element.name: Untethered Forms
element.description: Spend 3 ki to give your physical form and soul separate actions, bonus actions, and reactions.

element.name: Oath of Blood
element.description: The Oath of Blood demands a sacrifice of self in order to aid another.

element.name: Oath Spells (Blood)
element.description: 3rd: sanctuary, bless. 5th: revivify, warding bond. 9th: protection from energy, remove curse. 13th: death ward, stoneskin. 17th: dispel evil and good, wall of force.

element.name: Channel Divinity (Oath of Blood)
element.description: My Shield Is For Others (reaction to protect ally). Under My Light (grant 2d8 + level temp HP).

element.name: Sanguine Light (10 ft.)
element.description: When an ally within 10 ft. takes damage, your next attack deals +3 damage (cumulative).

element.name: Resilient Guardian
element.description: Designate an ally. If both of you are below half HP at the end of your turn, both regain 2d8 + level HP.

element.name: Sanguine Light (30 ft.)
element.description: Range increases to 30 ft.

element.name: Avatar of Sacrifice
element.description: Use Cha save for Dex/Con saves. Lose 10 HP to regain Channel Divinity. Divine Smite slots count as one level higher.

element.name: Mangangayaw
element.description: You have tempered your will to fight with speed and adrenaline.

element.name: Innate Speech
element.description: Use Wisdom instead of Charisma for Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion.

element.name: Striker's March
element.description: When targeted by an attack, speed increases by 15 ft., no opportunity attacks, reroll one weapon attack.

element.name: Lowering Strikes
element.description: Once per turn, deal extra 1d4 bleeding damage (increases to 2d4, 3d4).

element.name: Undertow
element.description: Move and shield an ally from an AoE by failing the save yourself.

element.name: Eternal March
element.description: Permanently under Striker's March. Add Wis mod to AC in medium armor.

element.name: Graverobber
element.description: Graverobbers are rogues who have imbued themselves with eldritch power via desecrating a grave.

element.name: Cursed Magic
element.description: Learn three warlock cantrips. Charisma is your spellcasting modifier.

element.name: Anathema
element.description: After Cunning Action, deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature within 30 ft. (Wis save). Type is Pestilence (poison), Avarice (psychic), or Destruction (force).

element.name: Eldritch Secrets
element.description: Learn an additional cantrip and gain features based on your curse manifestation.

element.name: Afflict Ruin
element.description: Curse a creature. Crit on 19-20 against it. It has disadvantage on Anathema saves. Regain HP when using Anathema.

element.name: Shroud of Desecration
element.description: Gain flying speed, move through objects, and force Con saves to poison on Sneak Attack.

element.name: Diwata Bloodline
element.description: You herald from a nature spirit of great power in the world.

element.name: Spirit's Cunning
element.description: Proficiency in Nature. Speak Sylvan. Advantage on Cha checks when speaking Sylvan.

element.name: Sorcerous Nature
element.description: Choose spells from the Druid list as Sorcerer spells.

element.name: Icon of the Spirit
element.description: Spend 2 Sorcery Points to summon an Icon. Touch spells can target creatures within 30 ft. of the Icon.

element.name: Icon's Territory
element.description: Teleport within 30 ft. of the Icon.

element.name: One with Nature
element.description: Spend 5 Sorcery Points to gain immunity to B/P/S, heal allies, and frighten enemies.

element.name: Mooneater Patron
element.description: You have made a pact with an entity of hunger—one of the Celestial Eaters.

element.name: Expanded Spell List (Mooneater)
element.description: 1st: inflict wounds, thunderwave. 2nd: enlarge/reduce, pass without trace. 3rd: call lightning, water walk. 4th: dominate beast, phantasmal killer. 5th: planar binding, telekinesis.

element.name: Celestial Yearning
element.description: Add Cha mod to initiative rolls.

element.name: Agent of Destruction
element.description: Pool of d6s equal to 1 + warlock level. Spend dice to add force damage to an attack.

element.name: Devour Essence
element.description: Absorb a dying creature to gain resistance to B/P/S and bonuses to attack and spell damage.

element.name: Eclipsing Fear
element.description: Immune to frightened. Reflect fear effects back at the attacker.

element.name: Cataclysmic Hunger
element.description: Advantage on initiative. On first turn, deal 8d8 force damage to creatures who haven't acted yet.

element.name: Lorechanter
element.description: You've spent your life learning the tales of your people with a fervent dedication.

element.name: Living Memory (Lorechanter)
element.description: Advantage on checks to recall histories or legends from your home island.

element.name: Mangangalakal
element.description: You are one well versed in trade and worth, skilled in bartering.

element.name: Shrewd Tongue
element.description: Advantage on checks to haggle or discern the true value of a good or service.

element.name: Panday
element.description: You are a crafter of heightened and dedicated skill.

element.name: Skilled Artisan
element.description: Crafting or repairing something related to your specialization requires half the usual cost.

element.name: Sea Raider
element.description: You were raised to traverse the sea and to fight alongside others.

element.name: Fearsome Sailor
element.description: When you attack a boat, you can reroll one damage die.

element.name: Voyager
element.description: Your life has known the sea all your life.

element.name: Uncharted Depths
element.description: Hold your breath for a minimum of 5 minutes.

element.name: Aswang Lineage
element.description: You were born into a family afflicted with evil.

element.name: Sinister Visage
element.description: Advantage on checks made to terrify or unnerve someone.

element.name: Apolaki's Light
element.description: A flare of solar light erupts. Target makes Con save. 1d12 radiant damage and blinded on fail. +1d12 per slot level above 1st.

element.name: Aqueous Affinity
element.description: Target gains swimming speed, no underwater attack disadvantage, advantage on Dex saves underwater.

element.name: Bonded Spirits
element.description: Spirit grants +1 to saves and 1d6 extra damage. +1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

element.name: Celestial Chaos
element.description: Storms of moonbeams and solar flares erupt. 12d12 radiant damage. Ongoing effects deal 6d12 fire or cold.

element.name: Commune with Great Spirits
element.description: Ask a great spirit up to three questions or request assistance with a natural phenomenon.

element.name: Control Lava
element.description: Control lava in a 100 ft. cube. Overflow, Part Lava, or Redirect Lava Flow.

element.name: Coral Cage
element.description: Coral erupts and traps a creature. 3d8 force damage and restrained on failed Dex save.

element.name: Create or Harden Lava
element.description: Create a 10-ft. cube of lava (2d10 fire) or harden lava into rock.

element.name: Cry of the Spirits
element.description: 30-ft. sphere. 12d6 force damage (Dex save halves). Incapacitates creatures reduced below 10x spell mod HP.

element.name: Eruption
element.description: 4d6 fire + 4d6 thunder damage in 30 ft. radius. Leaves difficult terrain.

element.name: False Self
element.description: Swap places with a false effigy to escape grapple or restraint.

element.name: Lava Plume
element.description: 5-ft. fountain of lava. 1d6 fire damage (Dex save negates). Scales at 5th, 11th, 17th.

element.name: Lizard Skin
element.description: 5 temp HP, +1 AC. Reaction to shed skin and escape grapple.

element.name: Mayari's Embrace
element.description: Moon tattoo. Full Moon (darkvision/advantage Cha), Half Moon (AC 16/Dodge), Crescent Moon (advantage melee/+15 speed), New Moon (invisibility/immune mind reading).

element.name: Mist of the Moon Twins
element.description: Friendly creatures see through mist, gain temp HP, and attacks against them miss on 60 or less on d100.

element.name: Molten Shell
element.description: Resistance to fire, 10 temp HP, 10 fire damage to melee attackers. Hardens to take half damage from next weapon hit.

element.name: Ride Lightning
element.description: Ride a bolt of lightning. 3d10 lightning damage in a line.

element.name: Shape Light
element.description: Moonlight (weapon +1d8 radiant), Starlight (wall of damage and disadvantage), Sunlight (sphere of radiant damage and blindness).

element.name: Spirit Dart
element.description: 1d8 elemental damage. More darts at 5th, 11th, 17th.

element.name: Tropical Paradise
element.description: Grove of fruit trees. 10 creatures gain poison immunity and increased max HP.

element.name: Viper's Eyes
element.description: Blindsight 60 ft. Ends early if taking fire/radiant damage and failing a Con save.

element.name: Volcanic Wall
element.description: Wall of lava. 6d6 fire damage. Can cool into permanent stone.

element.name: Wrath of Lalahon
element.description: Become molten rock. Temp HP, immune to elemental damage, 8d6 fire aura, auto-succeed concentration on fire/radiant spells.
